reviews.text: Many visits, wrong diagnosis. Animal euthanized at Viikki Animal Hospital because it had a bad stomach tumor. Vetek treated it as constipation and cleaned its teeth. Cruel and painful money laundering with animals. Do not take your pet there for treatment.

Friendly and kind service and in English as well. Cheaper and better than some of the bigger franchised vet clinics. Appointment by phone only but it's rare that you can't find an appointment for within a day or two. Highly recommend.

I've been talking my rescue dog to Vetek for a couple of years and every time it's a good experience. Even though she's afraid of strangers, she quickly warmed up to the vets and is positively excited going there, and her heart rate is always calm. Luckily I didn't have to bring her with anything serious, but every time the vets explain everything in detail, answer all questions, give good recommendations and aren't offering unnecessary tests. Once they told me if an issue doesn't resolve (it did) I should take her to a specialised vet elsewhere, it's great that they know the limits and aren't trying to get more appointments for an issue they might be unable to fix.

Every time the cost of procedures is lower than I expect which is a nice addition to the great service. Usually appointments are available in a few days or immediately. I appreciate that it's a small independent business. Also, they have a lot of beautiful plants!

Efficient, friendly and professional service from the entire clinic staff. I also think it is reasonably priced. A big thank you to the clinic staff. My dog ​​had stones in his paw, and they were removed.
